lines: This plan covers 2 days, starting Thursday 2026-09-10.
The plan sets 2 cooking sessions: Thursday and Friday.
The cooking days you gave do not fall within these days: the plan sets its sessions differently.
This window is short: 2 cooking session, no more — two on the same day would only be one.
Shopping and cooking first thing in the morning, so it is ready by lunch.
One shop, on Thursday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The shared base is vegetarian: that is Maya's line, and they have their own box. The rest of the table keeps theirs at 3 main meals out of 4.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.
Everyone has every one of their meals.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.
The shared meals use a vegetarian base with separate protein boxes, so the table can keep one practical batch while each plate follows its required food pattern.
Breakfast variety comes from one reheatable egg batch and fresh yoghurt bowls, keeping regular meals achievable within two cooking sessions.

dishes.name: Golden egg muffin plate
dishes.title: Egg oat muffins, yoghurt and apple
dishes.method: Assemble this shared plate first on a clean board with one clean spoon, adding one portion of egg oat muffins, the yoghurt and sliced apple. Close its box before starting the other breakfast, then wash the board, knife, spoon and worktop.
dishes.why: This is a filling, familiar breakfast that uses September apples and is ready in minutes.

dishes.name: Apple yoghurt oat bowl
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, oats, apple and honey
dishes.method: Only after the shared breakfast box is closed, spoon the yoghurt into a bowl, add the oats, diced apple and honey, and stir.
dishes.why: This cool, quick bowl gives the morning a dependable protein anchor with seasonal fruit.

dishes.name: Chicken halloumi rice bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, brown rice, halloumi and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat and box this shared lunch first, using one portion of chicken and rice, then add the halloumi, tomato and olive oil; use chickpeas instead of chicken in the vegetarian box. Close every box before starting the other lunch, then wash the board, knife, spoon and worktop and use fresh oil.
dishes.why: This substantial bowl combines a dependable starch with savoury cheese and fresh local tomatoes.

dishes.name: Lentil feta toast plate
dishes.title: Green lentils, feta, tomato and wholemeal bread
dishes.method: Only after the shared lunch boxes are closed, drain the lentils and assemble them with the bread, feta, sliced tomato and olive oil.
dishes.why: This inexpensive plate is hearty, fresh and easy to assemble during a busy lunch.

dishes.name: Rustic bean feta toast
dishes.title: Butter beans, feta, tomato and wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Assemble and box this shared dinner first on a clean board, spooning the beans over the toast and adding feta, tomato and olive oil. Close the box before starting the other dinner, then wash the board, knife, spoon and worktop.
dishes.why: This warm-weather supper is affordable, satisfying and quick enough for Thursday evening.

dishes.name: Savoury egg muffin supper
dishes.title: Egg oat muffins, tomato and wholemeal bread
dishes.method: Only after the shared dinner box is closed, reheat one portion of egg oat muffins and serve it with the bread and sliced tomato.
dishes.why: This uses the existing batch in a different format, keeping dinner easy without making it identical to breakfast.

dishes.name: Tomato egg muffin breakfast
dishes.title: Egg oat muffins, baked beans and tomatoes
dishes.method: Assemble this shared breakfast first on clean equipment with one portion of egg oat muffins, the baked beans and sliced tomato. Close its box before starting the other breakfast, then wash the board, knife, spoon and worktop.
dishes.why: A different topping makes the same useful batch feel fresh while keeping breakfast regular.

dishes.name: Plum cottage cheese toast
dishes.title: Cottage cheese, wholemeal bread and plum
dishes.method: Only after the shared breakfast box is closed, spread the cottage cheese over the bread and serve with sliced plum.
dishes.why: Cottage cheese and a British-season plum make a simple, portable breakfast with a change of flavour.

dishes.name: Herby meatball couscous
dishes.title: Beef meatballs, wholewheat couscous, feta and tomato
dishes.method: Reheat and box this shared lunch first using one portion of meatballs and couscous, then add the feta, tomato and olive oil; use cooked chickpeas instead of meatballs in the vegetarian box. Close all boxes before starting the other lunch, then wash the board, knife, spoon and worktop and use fresh oil.
dishes.why: This concentrated plate is practical for a larger lunch and keeps the fresh tomato portion crisp.

dishes.name: Cottage cheese bean toast
dishes.title: Cottage cheese, butter beans, tomato and wholemeal bread
dishes.method: Only after the shared lunch boxes are closed, assemble the cottage cheese, butter beans, bread and tomato, finishing with the olive oil.
dishes.why: This no-cook lunch is economical, filling and noticeably different from Thursday's lentil plate.

dishes.name: Roast chicken potato plate
dishes.title: Chicken, roast potatoes, feta and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat and box this shared dinner first with one portion of chicken and roast potatoes, adding the feta, tomato and olive oil; use chickpeas instead of chicken in the vegetarian box. Close every box before starting the other dinner, then wash the board, knife, spoon and worktop and use fresh oil.
dishes.why: Roast potatoes and tomatoes make a comforting end to the stretch while the chicken batch keeps the evening manageable.

dishes.name: Chickpea potato feta bowl
dishes.title: Roast potatoes, chickpeas, feta and tomatoes
dishes.method: Only after the shared dinner boxes are closed, reheat one portion of roast potatoes and assemble it with the chickpeas, feta, tomato and olive oil.
dishes.why: This changes the roast-potato batch into a fresh, protein-rich bowl rather than repeating the shared plate.

dishes.name: Cheddar bread side
dishes.title: Cheddar on wholemeal bread
dishes.method: Assemble the bread, cheddar and olive oil as a small rich side dish to eat with the shared lunch.
dishes.why: A compact, rich side that adds useful energy without another cooking session.

dishes.name: Feta bread side
dishes.title: Feta on wholemeal bread with olive oil
dishes.method: Assemble the bread, feta and olive oil as a small rich side dish to eat with the shared lunch.
dishes.why: A portable, rich side that fits alongside the main lunch without extra cooking.

preparations.title: Egg oat muffins
preparations.method: Heat the oven to 190°C. Grate the courgettes, whisk them with the eggs, oats and cheddar, then divide into a greased muffin tin and bake until firm and golden, about 25 minutes. Cool fully and box seven portions in the fridge.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Rub the chicken thighs with olive oil, smoked paprika and crushed garlic. Roast in a single layer at 190°C until browned and cooked through, about 40 minutes, then cool quickly and box six portions in the fridge.

preparations.title: Cooked brown rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice, simmer it in the water until tender, then spread it in a shallow container to cool quickly. Refrigerate three portions and use them on Thursday.

preparations.title: Herby beef meatballs
preparations.method: Mix the mince with the oats, eggs, finely chopped onion and oregano. Shape into meatballs, arrange on an oiled tray and roast at 190°C until browned and cooked through, about 25 minutes. Cool and box three portions in the fridge.

preparations.title: Pepper wholewheat couscous
preparations.method: Dice the peppers and soften them briefly in the olive oil, stir in the couscous and hot water, cover and leave until tender. Fluff with parsley, cool quickly and box three portions in the fridge for Friday.

preparations.title: Rosemary roast potatoes
preparations.method: Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces, toss with olive oil and rosemary, and roast at 210°C until crisp outside and tender inside, about 45 minutes. Cool and box four portions for Friday.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven and put in the egg muffins, chicken and meatballs on separate trays, with the shared batches made and boxed first. While they roast, cook the rice, prepare the couscous and chop the vegetables; cool the rice and couscous quickly, then box all batches and refrigerate.

Heat the oven, cut and season the potatoes, then roast them while assembling the other Friday meals. Cool and box four portions before lunch or dinner, keeping the shared box closed before preparing the separate plate.
